mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(c.id) AS contentId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name) AS tagNames, c.embedding_source_hash AS currentSourceHash FROM contents c LEFT JOIN content_tags ct ON ct.content_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE contents SET embedding_source_hash = #{hash} WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId})
